name: sports-props-engine
title: Pry Sports Props Engine
description: Comprehensive player prop betting intelligence: live props across 112+ books, lineup data, player recent stats with hot/cold streaks, defensive matchup context, and prop line movement tracking. Covers NBA, NFL, MLB, NHL player points, rebounds, assists, yards, touchdowns, strikeouts, and more. The most detailed player props actor on Apify.

input.title: Input schema for Pry Sports Props Engine
input.description: Player prop betting intelligence: live props across 112+ books, lineup data, player recent stats with hot/cold streaks, defensive matchup context, and prop line movement tracking.

urls.title: Target URLs
urls.description: One or more https:// URLs to process (ESPN / odds API endpoints to scrape).

sport.title: Sport
sport.description: Sport slug: nba, nfl, mlb, nhl, or any supported league key.

team.title: Team
team.description: Optional team filter (e.g. "Lakers", "Boston Celtics"). Used for lineup data and matchup context.

player_name.title: Player Name
player_name.description: Optional player filter (e.g. "LeBron James"). Narrows live props and recent stats to one player.

include_lineups.title: Include Lineups
include_lineups.description: Attach active/projected lineups, injury reports, and minutes projections.

include_stats.title: Include Recent Stats
include_stats.description: Attach last-N-games player stats with hot/cold streak trends.

include_matchup_context.title: Include Matchup Context
include_matchup_context.description: Attach defensive-ranking matchup context for the prop slate.

max_items.title: Max items (cost cap)
max_items.description: Hard cap on processed items for this run - keeps trial costs predictable. Billing stops when the cap or your spending limit is reached.

proxy_configuration.title: Proxy configuration
proxy_configuration.description: Apify proxy settings passed through to Pry's premium-proxy tier. Leave default to use the platform proxy automatically.
